newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Two Brazilian airforce pilots die in crash.
newsitem.headline: Two Brazilian airforce pilots die in crash.

text.p: Two Brazilian air force pilots were killed on Saturday when their twin-engine plane crashed while on a training mission, a military spokesman said.
The two pilots were preparing to land at the Campo Grande Airbase in the state of Mato Grosso do Sul, 2,000 miles (3400 km) west of Sao Paulo, when their plane went down, the spokesman said.
It was not immediately clear what caused the crash, which was under investigation, he said. The pilots, whose names were not released, were practicing navigation techniques, he said.
